answer: A sybil tax keeps fake identities out of the agent economy. Every new agent pays a 200-credit entry fee, burned not refunded, before trading. In this garden one gardener tends one plot, but an attacker planting 1,000 fake plots pays 200,000 credits. An honest agent reaches the summit with one fee, while a clone army pays 1,000 times for no gain. No zephyr of fake accounts drifts in free, since honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
